rule: A selected direction needs lookLock seven rules, buildPlan ready, lookMatch pass, and B12/Hupo benchmark pass before shot expansion. A mismatch below 0.55 is returned; do not call it a reproduction.
composition: subject scale and placement must match
foreground/background and negative space must match
light direction and contrast must match
no type/logo/text may be added to match the still; type is code later
assets: buildPlan.assets must be ready; missing = blocked
